title: Objects in practice
description: A quiet project list selects dimensional still lifes beside a separate image window.
useCase: Let a small studio index remain scannable while showing a rich preview for the focused project.
interaction: Hover, focus or choose a project.
reducedMotion: Preview changes and keyboard navigation settle immediately under reduced motion; host pause disables selections.
limitations: Three original CSS still lifes with no navigation or external images. Adapt the selected project state to actual product content.
look: Warm off-white page with a hairline-divided serif project list beside a shadowed taupe panel showing a soft sculpted object; the active title is rust.
motion: Hovering, focusing or clicking a title slides a vertical reel of stills inside the fixed preview window to that project in 240 ms with ease-out; keyboard input switches instantly.
adapt: The window holds a `.reel` translated by `selected` (`translateY`), with the `.24s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.25,1)` transition in the inline style. Replace `names` and the CSS-drawn `.still` shapes with real project titles and images.
